name: close_ratio_6mt
source: racing_game-owned close-ratio 6-speed performance manual, an invented design, NOT a specific gearbox [AS]. First 3.30, sixth 0.92 (nearly direct, a track gearbox gives up the overdrive); steps 1.39 / 1.32 / 1.26 / 1.24 / 1.25 keep the engine in its power band after every shift. Mesh efficiency 0.965-0.98 per gear (wide-face helical gears, slightly more friction than the touring box) [AS]. Synchro capacities are higher than the touring box (carbon-lined cone synchros) and the shift travel is short: neutral dwell 0.045 s, dog release 90 N*m [AS]; heavier shafts for the higher torque rating (input 0.012, output 0.016 kg*m2) [AS]. Reverse is synchronised (60 N*m) so an assisted selection from neutral works. Torque rating 550 N*m is kept in data/gearboxes/gearbox_catalog.json.
